name: Stirling PDF
author: Stirling-Tools
description: Locally hosted PDF toolbox: merge, split, compress, OCR, convert, rotate, watermark. One container on :8103 because code-server already owns Stirling's upstream :8080. Loopback-only behind Serve. Login is off — upstream defaults to a well-known admin/stirling pair, and the tailnet is the access boundary. Standard 2.14.3 image, not the fat extra-fonts build.
